nodes.norm_label: explicit environment and database destination validation
nodes.rationale: Reject settings database role host port and origin mismatches instead of inheriting legacy configuration.

nodes.label: Manifest-validated disposable PostgreSQL test laboratory
nodes.rationale: Persistent QA must never be a destructive pytest destination; disposable database provisioning requires authorized administrative authentication.

nodes.label: Environment-specific cookies secrets and same-origin proxy
nodes.norm_label: environment-specific cookies secrets and same-origin proxy
nodes.rationale: Cookies are not port-isolated; separate cookie names databases and keys coexist while sessionStorage is isolated by origin.

nodes.label: Encrypted initial credentials with interactive-only retrieval
nodes.norm_label: encrypted initial credentials with interactive-only retrieval
nodes.rationale: Passwords and PINs are stored as hashes; initial credentials are encrypted locally and retrieval refuses captured or redirected output.

nodes.label: Staff-declared external receipt and reversal

nodes.label: Idempotent seed preserves data credentials tokens and history

nodes.label: Seed manifest reference integrity and local protected backups
